title: Adjudicatory hearing in the matter of a possible violation of G.L. C82 Sec. 40 by Boston Edison Company.

milestones.label: Reconsideration or appeal
milestones.detail: : The case 90-DS-5 involving a possible Dig Safe violation by Boston Edison was resolved before the appeal. (Adjudicatory Hearing) to the satisfaction of both parties (BECO & the Division) Pipeline Engineering and Safety. This being so, the appeal at this adjudicatory level is hereby dismissed. By: Douglas Denny-Brown, Hearing Officer, DPU (90-DS-5).
